28K likes, 200 comments - nasa on October 22, 2026: "Creepy crawly crater 🕷️
 
The Spider Crater in Australia, the product of a meteorite impact followed by hundreds of millions of years of erosion, could cause a fright! Its “legs” are sandstone ridges that stayed while other rocks were worn away.
 
#NASA #Earth #Spider".
